answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The protection is robust because the trusted grader set is drawn from established agents, which keeps a sudden flood of new keys from capturing majority control.
